description: Defines data structures and classes for resource element (RE) measurements in a wireless communication system, including dimensions, container interfaces, and various implementations (static and dynamic) for handling RE measurement data.

classes.name: re_measurement_dimensions
classes.description: Data structure representing the dimensions of resource element measurements, including number of subcarriers, OFDM symbols, and slices.

classes.name: re_measurement
classes.description: Abstract interface class for RE measurements container, providing methods to access and resize measurement data.

classes.name: modular_re_measurement
classes.description: Template class for modular resource element measurements, allowing views and subsetting of RE data.

classes.name: re_measurement_tensor_base
classes.description: Base class template for tensor-based RE measurement containers, supporting set and get operations on slices and symbols.

classes.name: static_re_measurement
classes.description: Fixed-size, compile-time allocated RE measurement container.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the RE measurement container.

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.description: Returns a span (view) over the measurement data for a specific symbol and slice.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the internal buffer to match specified dimensions.

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Writes data into a specific slice of the measurement tensor.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Allocates memory for the container based on specified dimensions.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Copies views from another measurement object, with optional subcarrier offset.
